BrochureContent.Content:
TOM MCDONALD & ASSOCIATES - EXPERIENCED, PROFESSIONAL, TRUSTED - are proud to present this outstanding 4/5-bedroom detached residence, ideally positioned in what is widely regarded as one of Portarlington’s most desirable residential locations.

Perfectly situated within walking distance of schools, the train station, shops, and the full range of amenities that Portarlington has to offer, this impressive family home combines convenience, comfort, and style in equal measure. Extending to approximately 1,395 sq. ft., the property has been meticulously maintained and presented in excellent condition throughout, offering spacious and versatile accommodation for today’s modern lifestyle.

From the moment you step through the front door, the quality and care invested in this home are immediately apparent.

The welcoming entrance hall leads to a beautifully appointed living room, where a solid fuel open fireplace creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. A bespoke framed television feature provides the perfect focal point for family movie nights or relaxing evenings at home.

At the heart of the property lies the expansive kitchen/dining area. Finished with tiled flooring and a quality fitted kitchen complete with oven, hob, dishwasher, and fridge freezer, this space has been designed for both everyday family living and entertaining. Natural light floods the room, while sliding patio doors seamlessly connect the indoors with the outdoor entertaining area.

A versatile second reception room on the ground floor offers exceptional flexibility and can easily serve as a fifth bedroom, playroom, guest accommodation, or additional family living space. A utility room with fitted units, plumbing for a washing machine, and independent access to the exterior further enhances practicality, while a guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

Step outside and discover a superb outdoor space designed for year-round enjoyment.

The attractive decking area, complete with pergola, provides an ideal setting for al fresco dining, entertaining guests, or simply unwinding in comfort regardless of the weather. The covered side entrance offers valuable additional storage, while the secure rear garden is partially walled and designed for low-maintenance living, allowing more time to relax and enjoy your surroundings.

Upstairs, four generously proportioned bedrooms provide excellent accommodation.

Each bedroom benefits from fitted wardrobes, while three feature comfortable carpet flooring. The fourth bedroom is currently configured as a home office, perfectly suited to remote working thanks to the property's fibre broadband connection.

The principal bedroom enjoys the luxury of a fully tiled en-suite bathroom, while the stylish main family bathroom has been finished to an exceptional standard. Features include a walk-in shower, rainwater pump shower, and contemporary anti-frost mirror, creating a spa-inspired retreat within the home.

This exceptional property is packed with Modern Features & Energy-Efficient Enhancements

Few homes offer such an exceptional combination of location and lifestyle. Residents can enjoy easy access to excellent schools, commuter rail services, shopping facilities, sporting amenities, and the vibrant town centre, making this a truly outstanding choice for growing families, , and commuters alike.

Beautifully presented, exceptionally maintained, and ideally located, this is a property that effortlessly delivers on every level. Combining generous living space, modern conveniences, excellent outdoor entertaining areas, and a highly sought-after address, this home represents a rare opportunity to secure a premium family residence in the heart of Portarlington.

Viewing is highly recommended. This is more than a house – it is a place to call home.

Let’s make it yours.
